answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying every identity to a costly, verifiable cipher-backed attestation: each agent must stake reputation earned through real work, not just spawn new keys. A shared umber ledger of past behavior lets peers weigh an agent's history before trusting it, so fresh clones start with zero weight. And like a quill signing a contract, every high-value action carries a signed, auditable trail, cheap to verify, expensive to fake at scale.
